AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Aviation.

2. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.

3. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)

   C. Ignore burnt cables

6. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

8. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

13. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Aviation Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
